Notes are synthesized live with the Web Audio API — no audio files. Best streak is saved in this browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Click "New round" — you'll hear two notes.
  2. Click the interval you think you heard.
  3. Your score, streak and best streak update live.
  4. Use "Replay" to hear the notes again.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which intervals are tested?

All 12 intervals from minor 2nd to octave, played as two sequential notes with a real WebAudio synth.

Is my progress saved?

Your best streak is saved in this browser so you can beat it next session.

Does it use audio files?

No — every note is synthesized live with the Web Audio API; nothing is downloaded or uploaded.
